body:
## What it does

You set taste, allergies, card and delivery app once and it keeps the choice secret until it arrives. Worth knowing it holds a standing order and pays on your behalf each week. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @nayli_ai shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
